subject: Renewal & expansion pricing — volume step-ups and blended rates
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Park <jasmine@stellarretailexample.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, Jun 1, 2027 at 3:12 PM PDT
Subject: Renewal & expansion pricing — volume step-ups and blended rates

Thanks again for taking the time today, Jasmine — great conversation. Quick recap and next steps so we have alignment:

Call recap:
- Current monthly usage: ~25M tokens (inference + embeddings mix).
- Target expansion: ramp to ~75M tokens/month over the next 9–12 months (adding new model routes + more inference traffic).
- Budget / unit economics: you mentioned a target of roughly $200–$250 per 1M tokens as an internal goal.

High-level pricing approach we discussed:
- Provide a stepped volume discount schedule (step-up tiers) + blended-rate examples at target volumes so you can model spend.
- Include per-route considerations (e.g., cheaper rate for embeddings-only routes, premium for LLM-heavy routes).
- Offer commitment options (12/24 months) that further reduce unit price.

Attachments: sending the usage estimates and a draft mutual action (MA) plan for internal review: 1) 20270601-usage-estimates.csv 2) Stellar_Retail_MA_plan.xlsx.

Next steps:
1) I’ll send a short proposal with step-up tiers and blended-rate examples by EOD Thursday (Jun 3).
2) You’ll loop in procurement (Alex?) to confirm budget constraints and preferred contract cadence.
3) Let’s pencil an exec review on Mon Jun 7 (30 min) after you’ve reviewed the proposal.

If any of the numbers above are off, reply with corrections and I’ll update the calc sheet. Thanks — looking forward to getting this over the line.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Jasmine Park <jasmine@stellarretailexample.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@stellarretailexample.com>
Date: Wed, Jun 2, 2027 at 10:08 AM PDT
Subject: Re: Renewal & expansion pricing — volume step-ups and blended rates

Thanks, Marissa — helpful recap. A couple quick clarifications from our side: 

- Confirming current baseline is 25M tokens/mo and the goal is to hit ~75M by Q2 next year (12-month ramp).
- Procurement & finance have flagged a target blended unit of around $200/1M tokens — upper bound $220/1M if necessary.
- Adding new routes: these will include a) short-form summarization (high qps, smaller context), b) embeddings for search (volume-heavy but lower cost per call), and c) a small number of high-cost long-context routes for LLM work.

Can you include two blended-rate scenarios in the proposal: one that pegs blended at $220/1M and one that pegs it at $200/1M (so we can see how much commitment or step-ups are required)? Also, does adding the new routes materially change the blended rate assumptions (e.g., separate pricing buckets for embedding vs LLM inference)?

Looping Alex from procurement on this thread — Alex, any constraints we should flag up front (billing cadence, PO lead time, contract length)?

- Jasmine
Head of AI Platform | Stellar Retail
jasmine@stellarretailexample.com

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, Jun 3, 2027 at 5:03 PM PDT
Subject: Proposal (step-up tiers + blended-rate scenarios) — Stellar Retail

Jasmine — attaching the proposal I mentioned. Quick summary here so it’s easy to review in-thread. Attachment: Stellar_proposal_v2.pdf

Proposed stepped pricing (example, list pricing per 1M tokens):
- Tier A (0–50M): $300 / 1M
- Tier B (50–150M): $200 / 1M
- Tier C (150M+): $150 / 1M

Blended-rate examples (effective $ per 1M at volume):
- At 25M/month (current): blended = $300 (all in Tier A).
- At 75M/month (projected ramp): blended = ((50*$300) + (25*$200)) / 75 = $266.67 per 1M
- With a committed 12-month minimum and 10% commitment discount applied to the schedule above, 75M blended ≈ $240 / 1M

Two scenarios you requested:
1) Goal blended ≈ $220/1M — to hit this we can: commit to a 12–24 month volume commitment + elevate Tier B threshold (e.g., Tier A 0–30M @ $320, Tier B 30–120M @ $190) — see calc tab in the PDF.
2) Goal blended ≈ $200/1M — this requires a stronger commitment (24 months + minimum average >= 100M/mo) or an up-front reserved capacity commitment (Dedicated capacity).

Per-route adders / discounts:
- Embeddings-only routes: baseline is typically 40–60% of inference LLM rate — we can include per-route multipliers in the final SOW so the blended rate reflects the traffic mix.
- Long-context LLM routes: priced at a premium (suggest adders in the proposal) or placed on a separate billable route to avoid degrading overall blended math.

Next steps / asks:
- Jasmine / Alex: confirm whether procurement prefers monthly vs quarterly billing and if PO lead time (30 vs 60 days) is a hard constraint.
- If the $200–$220 target is firm, we’ll put together two commercial options in the proposal: 12-month commit and 24-month reserved capacity + blended examples.
- If agreeable, I’ll pull a short exec-facing 15-min deck and a DocuSign route for the preferred option. DocuSign preview: https://www.docusign.com/Envelopes/12345

I’ve attached the proposal (Stellar_proposal_v2.pdf) and updated the usage tab with the blended math and sensitivity analysis. Let me know if you want me to run a separate calc with a higher embedding share — happy to do that.

Thanks —
Marissa
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
